cues: Its frame supports two aligned wheels, while a chain transfers pedal motion to the rear hub.
Rubber tires cushion narrow rims as spokes distribute weight across each wheel.
A pair of handlebars lets the rider steer by pivoting the front fork.
Cranks connect foot-powered pedals to a toothed chainring that drives the rear wheel.
A lightweight frame balances strength between the seat tube and steering head.
Brake pads press against the rims, slowing the rider when hand levers are pulled.
